notes: Source: 2024-2026 Pearl River Community College Catalog, Associate Degree Nursing (ADN), Traditional Option (catalog pp. 76-77). Official four-level sequence; recorded as four semester blocks. A graduate is conferred the Associate in Applied Science (AAS) degree and is eligible for NCLEX-RN. Program accredited by ACEN. ADN general education courses require a grade of C or better; all required NUR courses require a B or better. Catalog lists 'MAT 1313/4' and 'ENG 1113/4'; recorded at 3 credits each (the 3-credit versions) per published level totals. Per convention, all entries recorded at published credit values. Optional nursing electives (NUR 1011, 1012, 1203, 1303, 2013) are not required and not included. Additional catalog notes: students applying Fall 2020 or later must complete orientation (LLS 1313; LLS 1311 for transfer students) prior to graduation, which is not part of the published 72-hour total; Technical Mathematics cannot substitute for College Algebra in this program.
